experiment_template.research_question: Does the exact H15 instruction improvement replicate in the missing window/variant conditions?
stop_conditions: Do not modify or pool H15 outcomes.
Stop on source drift, uncertain dispatch, transport or worker cleanup failure.

success_criteria.exposure: Every trial must actually recycle and confirm required reads/archive recovery without unsafe dispatch or unknown delivery
success_criteria.primary: Fewer no-ops, no raw semantic regression, more qualified repairs, at least 7/8 qualified treatment repairs
success_criteria.unknown: Missing/transport evidence or no baseline no-op exposure remains inconclusive

falsifier: The prospective replication misses no-op reduction, semantic non-regression, qualified improvement or its 7/8 treatment floor despite complete attributable exposure.
mechanism: Literal byte preservation in the higher-priority system message can dominate repair intent and a later user-level review card. The candidate removes this conflict without changing scope, schema or pager.
scope: Targeted paired replication of one known family; no new candidate tuning, no serving activation, no replacement of original small-window qualification.
statement: The exact H15 clarified source instruction reduces unchanged-source failures and improves complete repairs in the missing 8K and archive-end conditions.
